messages: Mentally exhausted from endless adventuring, a peaceful rest sounds pretty good right now.
It seems #m10001000# offers various services for adventurers. I should drop by #m10001000# if I'm ever in the area.\r\n#rOnly characters at Level 12 or higher can complete this quest.#k
#p229#, the Town Clerk I met at #m10001007#, suggested I become a resident of #m10001000#. Once I've made up my mind, I should speak with #p229# for more details.
